AdminAction.description: What an admin (or the command line, with no actor) did.
AdminAction.title: AdminAction

AdminEvent.description: `actor` is null for the command line or a deleted admin, `target` for a deleted user.
AdminEvent.title: AdminEvent

AdminUserUpdate.description: Only the fields that are sent change.
AdminUserUpdate.title: AdminUserUpdate

CodeInfo.description: A usable code. `username` is set for reset codes only (the account being reset).
CodeInfo.title: CodeInfo

CoupleState.description: The own couple (`partner`, accepted at `since`) and pending requests.
CoupleState.title: CoupleState

ErrorCode.description: What went wrong; the frontend shows the translation `error.<code>`.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorResponse.description: `params` fill placeholders in the translation; `fields` lists rejected request fields.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

FieldError.description: One rejected request field; `loc` is its path, e.g. `["body", "name"]`.
FieldError.title: FieldError

FieldErrorCode.description: Why a single request field was rejected (`fields[].code` in the envelope).
FieldErrorCode.title: FieldErrorCode

FilterHidden.description: User filter chips this user has switched off, per screen (MEAL-10, UI-02).
FilterHidden.title: FilterHidden

InviteCreate.description: `tailscale_share_url`: the optional share link for step 1 of the invite message.
InviteCreate.title: InviteCreate

InviteCreated.description: The new invite and its link (`/join#<code>`); the code is shown only this once.
InviteCreated.title: InviteCreated

LinkCreated.description: A reset link; the code is in the fragment (`/reset#<code>`).
LinkCreated.title: LinkCreated

LoginResponse.description: `access_token` goes into `Authorization: Bearer`; it expires after `expires_in` s.
LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse

MeUpdate.description: Only the fields that are sent change (ACC-13, VIS-02, I18N-01).
MeUpdate.title: MeUpdate

RefreshRequest.description: `fork` asks for a new, independent session (first start of the Home Screen app).
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

SecurityInfo.description:
What *Me → Security* shows, e.g. "Password reset by X on <date>" (ACC-10).

`password_reset_by` is null for a reset link from the command line or a deleted admin.
SecurityInfo.title: SecurityInfo

SessionInfo.description: A logged-in device; `current` is the one making this request (ACC-09).
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

UserRef.description: Another user as everyone sees them; deactivated users are shown with a note (ADM-02).
UserRef.title: UserRef

VersionInfo.description: What is running and where its source is (LIC-02, AGPL § 13).
VersionInfo.title: VersionInfo

HTTPBearer.description: The access token from login, refresh, join or reset.
